requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the arrest, citation or warrant, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the arrest, citation or warrant, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the arrest, citation or warrant, from your own criminal history record or court paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Agency that arrested, cited, or sought the warrant, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Agency that arrested, cited, or sought the warrant, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the agency that arrested you, cited you or sought the warrant, from your own criminal history record or court paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case or event number the record carries, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case or event number the record carries, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no record identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case or event number, copied from your own criminal history record or court paperwork

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The disposition, and the date it became final, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The disposition, and the date it became final, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen, and finality is the section's one temporal condition
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the case ended and the date that outcome became final, exactly as the court record states them - the court that handled the case can provide a certified copy

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Other names the applicant has used, including any former legal names, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Other names the applicant has used, including any former legal names, on the Central Repository copy of the application
requiredBeforeFiling.why: what other names the participant has used is the participant's own fact, not one the platform holds
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: every other name you have used, including former legal names, or NONE - the repository indexes by identity, and an application under one name may not reach a record filed under another

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the agency which maintains the record, in the address block of the agency copy

requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and mailing address of the agency that arrested you, cited you or sought the warrant - the agency's own website or the court that handled the case can confirm the address
